room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken. Optional add-on available to enhance room rent limit by 50% or 100% for Gold/Diamond/Platinum plans.

icu.note: Applies across all plans (Silver, Gold, Diamond, Platinum).

copayment.note: Compulsory 10% co-pay on every claim under Silver plan. Waiver available on payment of extra premium. Additionally, 20% co-pay for persons aged 65-70 under Silver/Gold plans.

sub_limits.display: Advanced treatments sub-limited; ambulance, maternity, domiciliary capped
sub_limits.note: Robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation etc. have per-policy-period sub-limits. Maternity capped at 2.5% of SI. Domiciliary capped (Silver: 10% SI max ₹25k; others max ₹50k). Ambulance per-illness and per-policy caps.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the base policy.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 48 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Most listed conditions (cataract, hernia, hydrocele, BPH, etc.) have 2-year wait. Some (ENT benign disorders, polycystic ovary) have 1-year wait. Joint replacement 4 years, osteoporosis 5 years. Hypertension/diabetes 90 days.

maternity.note: Limited to 2.5% of SI per delivery; max 2 deliveries/terminations in lifetime. Not available under Silver or Gold plans. New born baby cover also included up to 90 days.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Discount was discontinued under HFF-2015 and is not offered as a standard ongoing benefit under HFF-2021. A one-time NCD credit from previous HFF policy is allowed on first renewal only.

restoration.display: Optional; 50% or 100% of SI (Silver & Gold only)
restoration.note: Restoration is an optional paid add-on available only under Silver and Gold plans. Aggregate restored amount capped at 50%/100% of SI as opted. Not available under Diamond or Platinum plans.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days from discharge.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (Appendix I) + others with prior approval
day_care.note: Appendix I lists 180 day-care procedures. Other day-care treatments require prior written approval from Company/TPA.

domiciliary.note: Covered but excludes treatments lasting 3 days or less and 10 specified conditions (asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, etc.). Capped at 10% of SI (Silver) or ₹50,000 (Gold/Diamond/Platinum).

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered up to full SI when insured is recipient. Lump sum 10% of SI when insured is donor (after 12 months continuous coverage).

ambulance.note: Silver: ₹1,000/illness, max ₹3,000/policy period. Gold: ₹2,000/illness, max ₹6,000. Diamond: ₹3,000/illness, max ₹8,000. Platinum: ₹5,000/illness, max ₹15,000. All subject to 1% of SI cap.

modern_treatments.note: 12 advanced/modern treatments covered (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, etc.) but with per-policy-period sub-limits ranging from ₹40,000 to ₹2,00,000 depending on SI slab.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, diapers, etc.) explicitly excluded in Appendix Lists I–IV. No optional rider for consumables mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy can be extended to SAARC countries on written request before travel; no extra premium. No cashless outside India; reimbursement only. Not available for other international destinations.

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years, no look-back except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Applies separately to enhanced SI portions.

grace_period.note: No coverage during grace period. Diseases contracted during break treated as PED.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies and as a one-time option for first-time renewals into HFF-2021. Not applicable on subsequent renewals.

portability.note: Apply at least 45 days before renewal date as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: Sarcoidosis, many cancers, epilepsy, heart ailments, stroke, IBD, CKD, Hepatitis B, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's permanently excluded if pre-disclosed; OPD (except Platinum); dental (unless injury); spectacles/hearing aids; hormone therapy

optional_riders.display: Restoration of SI (Silver/Gold), Personal Accident (worldwide), Life Hardship Survival Benefit (critical illness lump sum), Waiver of proportionate deduction, Waiver of Silver co-pay, SAARC extension
